Victorian freight traffic observations

Source: R/data.R
traffic_counts.Rd

Traffic observations collected from Victorian road monitoring locations between May and October 2026. Each row represents a recorded vehicle count for a particular date, time interval, monitoring site, vehicle class and speed bin.

Usage

data(traffic_counts)

Format

A data frame with 12,637,766 rows and 14 columns:

date

Date of the traffic observation.

time_bin

15-minute observation interval.

site

Monitoring site identifier.

heading

Direction of travel.

vehicle_class

Recorded vehicle classification.

speed_bin

Vehicle speed category.

volume

Number of vehicles recorded in the interval.

source_file

Original daily CSV filename.

classification_scheme

Vehicle classification scheme used.

month

Month of the observation.

site_description

Description of the monitoring location.

latitude

Latitude of the monitoring location.

longitude

Longitude of the monitoring location.

site_metadata_match

Whether matching site metadata was found.

Source

Victorian Department of Transport, Telemetry Traffic Counts and Classification dataset.

Details

The dataset contains the original traffic fields together with additional information from the site reference data, including site descriptions, coordinates and metadata matching indicators.

See also

telemetry_sites for monitoring site reference information and site_day_coverage for daily reporting coverage.
